questions.explanation: Active listening means giving the speaker full attention, understanding their point, and responding thoughtfully — not just waiting to talk.
options: Waiting for your turn to speak
Fully focusing on the speaker, understanding, and then responding
Taking notes of every word
Agreeing with everything the speaker says
questions.question: What does active listening mainly involve?

questions.explanation: Asking a short clarifying question up front prevents wasted work and is normal professional practice.
options: Guess what they meant and start
Ask a clarifying question before starting
Ask a colleague to guess with you
Wait and hope it becomes clear later
questions.question: You do not understand an instruction from your manager. What is the best action?

questions.explanation: A clear, specific subject line tells the reader exactly what the email is about.
options: Meeting
Important!!!
Request to reschedule Thursday's project meeting
Hi
questions.question: Which subject line is best for a work email asking to reschedule a project meeting?

questions.explanation: Letting people finish and noting your points shows respect and keeps the meeting productive.
options: Check your phone quietly
Interrupt as soon as you have an idea
Listen without interrupting and note your points for later
Finish their sentences to save time
questions.question: When a colleague is speaking in a meeting, good practice is to…

questions.explanation: Specific feedback about work or behaviour, with a concrete example, is actionable; comments about personality are not.
options: About their personality
Specific and about the work or behaviour, with an example
Given in front of a large group
Delayed by several months
questions.question: Feedback to a colleague is most useful when it is…

questions.explanation: Flagging a delay early, with a realistic revised date, lets others plan and protects trust.
options: Say nothing and hope nobody notices
Inform the concerned person early and propose a revised date
Blame another team member
Hand in unfinished work without comment
questions.question: You realise you will miss a deadline. What is the best practice?

questions.explanation: "Best regards" is a standard, professional sign-off for formal email.
options: Cheers!!!
Best regards
Bye bye
Sent from my phone
questions.question: Which closing is appropriate for a formal work email?

questions.explanation: A quick proofread catches errors that can confuse the reader or change the meaning of the message.
options: To make the email longer
Errors can change the meaning and look unprofessional
Proofreading is only needed for spellings in your name
It is not necessary if you are in a hurry
questions.question: Why should you proofread an important email before sending it?
